verdict.rationale: PayPal documents a self-contained sandbox that simulates production and lets developers test API calls without touching live accounts. The agentic surfaces (toolkit, cart API) ride the same REST rails, so the sandbox plausibly covers them, but no evidence shows it explicitly supports agent-commerce flows. missing for 10: explicit sandbox documentation for the agentic services (Store Sync, Agent Ready ACP/UCP paths, cart reverse API, MCP server), hands-on or independent confirmation that agent flows run in sandbox.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: is a self-contained, virtual testing environment that simulates the live PayPal production environment
the sandbox mirrors the features on the PayPal production servers
